capabilities: Group notes and folders into named projects
Restore a project's tabs, scroll position, and active tab on click
Add and manage multiple named panes per project
Pin and browse a project's notes and folders in a sidebar pane
Sync project folders with a Google Drive folder, including revisions and additive merge
disambiguation: Not a project-management tool; it saves and restores sets of folders, notes, and open tabs as switchable workspaces.
extras: Google Drive integration is desktop-only. Sync is one-way and additive: downloads and uploads never delete files on either side. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to switch between groups of notes while preserving each group's open tabs, scroll positions, and pane state.

relations.evidence: can sync with a Google Drive folder

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Project workspace manager that groups notes and folders into projects and restores each project's open tabs and layout when clicked.
